claims.text: High-entropy alloys can provide superior comprehensive performance.
High-entropy alloys are suitable for lightweight applications.
High-entropy alloys exhibit a high-entropy effect, lattice-distortion effect, sluggish-diffusion effect, and cocktail effect.
The high-entropy, lattice-distortion, sluggish-diffusion, and cocktail effects enhance the strength of high-entropy alloys.
The high-entropy, lattice-distortion, sluggish-diffusion, and cocktail effects enhance the ductility of high-entropy alloys.
The high-entropy, lattice-distortion, sluggish-diffusion, and cocktail effects enhance the corrosion resistance of high-entropy alloys.
High-entropy alloys can simultaneously exhibit improved strength and ductility.
High-entropy alloys can exhibit improved corrosion resistance.
The asserted performance applies to as-cast or as-fabricated high-entropy alloys.
The asserted performance applies under mechanical loading, thermal treatment, and corrosive environments.
Available data on the proposed use of high-entropy alloys are limited.
The complexity of high-entropy-alloy systems and limited data create uncertainty in property predictions.

contradictions.description: The intervention is stated to be 'None,' while thermal treatment is listed among the applicable conditions; thermal treatment would ordinarily constitute a material intervention or processing step.
